title: Sandkit modinfo.json

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URL for editors (for example VS Code). Not read by the game loader.

manifestVersion.description: Manifest format version. Must be `1` for Sandkit `apiVersion` 1.

id.description: Unique mod id. Prefer `author.mod-name` (matches folder / Workshop identity).

name.description: Display name shown in the mod list and Workshop UI.

apiVersion.description: Sandkit host API version this mod targets. Must be `1`.

entry.description: Main-thread script path relative to the mod root (for example `"main.js"`). Omit for texture-only, map-only, or config-only mods that declare another capability instead.

workerEntry.description: Simulation-worker script path relative to the mod root. Required when the mod registers worker hooks or uses worker-only APIs.

patches.description: Path to the patches file relative to the mod root (usually `"patches.json"`). When omitted, a present `patches.json` may still auto-load per official docs.

description.description: Long description shown in the mod list / Workshop.

gameVersion.description: Inclusive game version range this mod claims to support.

dependencies.description: Other mod ids that should load with this mod.

loadOrder.description: Relative load priority. Lower values load earlier; higher values load later.

configSchema.description: Player-facing settings schema. Keys are setting ids; values define type and UI. Read at runtime with `api.settings.get`.

configOverrides.description: Paths to JSON config overrides keyed by vanilla config id (for example `"drill"`).

shaderOverrides.description: Paths to GLSL shader replacements keyed by shader id (for example `"sky"`).

textureOverrides.description: Texture replacements keyed by vanilla texture id. A string value is a path; an object adds spritesheet frame metadata.

provides.description: Optional content this mod publishes for others to consume.

map.description: Embedded custom map pack definition for this mod.

description:
Sandkit mod manifest (`modinfo.json`).

Required for every mod folder. Minimal script mods need manifestVersion , id , name , version , apiVersion , and entry .

At least one capability is required: entry , workerEntry , configOverrides , textureOverrides , provides , or map . `configSchema` alone does not count.

ModGameVersion.description: Compatible game version range for the mod.

ConfigSchemaEntry.description:
One entry under `modinfo.json` `configSchema`.

Keys of `configSchema` are setting ids read via `api.settings.get`.

default.description: Value used when the player has not changed the setting.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound for the setting.

max.description: Inclusive upper bound for the setting.

step.description: UI step size for the number control.

label.description: Plain-text label shown in the settings UI.

labelKey.description: i18n key for the settings label (preferred over label when both exist).

description.description: Plain-text help text for the setting.

descriptionKey.description: i18n key for the setting help text.

default.description: Value used when the player has not changed the setting.

label.description: Plain-text label shown in the settings UI.

labelKey.description: i18n key for the settings label.

description.description: Plain-text help text for the setting.

descriptionKey.description: i18n key for the setting help text.

label.description: Plain-text label shown in the settings UI.

labelKey.description: i18n key for the settings label.

description.description: Plain-text help text for the setting.

descriptionKey.description: i18n key for the setting help text.

value.description: Stored value written when the player picks this option.

labelKey.description: i18n key for the option label.

path.description: Path to the replacement image, relative to the mod root.

frameWidth.description: Width in pixels of one animation frame.

frames.description: Number of frames in the spritesheet.

TextureOverride.description: Animated (or static) texture replacement for a vanilla asset id.

id.description: Id of this provide entry within its kind.

textureOverrides.description: Texture paths keyed by the vanilla or structure texture id they replace.

ModProvide.description: Optional content pack exposed by this mod for other mods or the game to consume.

blueprints.description: Paths to blueprint images and map config under the mod root.

spawn.description: Player spawn position in world pixels.

unstuck.description: Unstuck / rescue position in world pixels.

deployment.description: Deployment mode for the map (for example `"skip"`).

topBounds.description: Vertical travel bounds at the top of the world.

colorMappings.description: Maps blueprint RGB keys (`"r, g, b"`) to terrain ids or layered terrain.

ModMapBlueprints.description:
Blueprint image paths for a custom map pack.

Paths are relative to the mod root.

hard.description: Hard top bound in world pixels.

soft.description: Soft top bound in world pixels.

ModMapTopBounds.description: Vertical camera / travel bounds for the custom map.

startY.description: World Y where depth light scaling starts.

endY.description: World Y where depth light scaling ends.

maxSize.description: Maximum light size at the shallow end of the range.

minSize.description: Minimum light size at the deep end of the range.

ModMapDepthLight.description: Depth-based light sizing for the custom map.

widthScale.description: Horizontal scale of the parallax layer.

offsetY.description: Vertical offset of the parallax layer in pixels.

ModMapParallax.description: Parallax background tuning for the custom map.

ModMapColorMapping.description: One `map.colorMappings` value: a single terrain id, or layered background/foreground ids.

background.description: Background terrain id for this blueprint RGB.

foreground.description: Foreground terrain id for this blueprint RGB.

ModMapColorMappingLayers.description: Color-map cell that paints both background and foreground terrain.
